commands.submit: flwr run APP bench --run-config 'sites=4 mib=32 rounds=4 result-file="..."' --stream

notes: SIGKILL in round 2: at least one SuperNode had received its round 2 message, see at_kill.
The killed SuperLink is reaped at once, as init or a shell would, so its pid is gone.
Restart is outage_seconds after the kill, with the same flags, port and database file.
With process isolation, kill `tree` also kills and restarts the separate SuperExec.
Watching stops early only once the run is finished and every SuperNode is online.
Resubmit is a new `flwr run` of the same app after watching, to the same federation. If SuperNodes have exited it waits 30 s, then restarts them with the same flags.
No Flower code changed. Stock FedAvg, with no checkpointing added to the app.
Merged from one crash.py invocation per group of trials, see each trial's command.

Two earlier trials are not in this file. sqlite, superlink kill, 2 s outage, subprocess: running from +8.8 s, finished:failed 'No heartbeat received from the task' at +61.0 s. sqlite, superlink kill, 2 s outage, process isolation: finished:completed at +20.2 s, right model. Same outcomes as the matching trials below apart from the status race.
